verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly supports leaving Datadog. Its OpenTelemetry support [datadog-docs-2] keeps instrumentation vendor-neutral, and one customer confirms using OTel with Datadog [datadog-comm-1]. A public API reference [datadog-docs-24] suggests data can be retrieved programmatically, but no evidence documents a bulk or complete export of stored logs, metrics, traces, dashboards or monitors in open formats. Missing for 10: documented full-data export feature, export of stored telemetry and configuration in open formats, migration/offboarding guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of a successful export.
